name: sentence_chain
summary: The FREE 4th retrieval axis — pure-Python NLP heuristics produce a 96-dim L2-normalized sentence embedding with zero LLM calls and zero model loads. Old-school tricks: suffix-based POS proxies, stop-word filtering, n-gram bucketing, skeleton hashing, subject-verb-object state machine, and chain-context modulation (prior sentences bias the embedding). Pairs with tri_modal_embedder (vector + wave + time) to make the full 4D MoE retrieval substrate.
engine_pattern: pure Python stdlib only (re, math, string, collections, hashlib/blake3). No numpy. No nltk. No spaCy. No transformers. Sub-100ms per sentence.

embedding_layout_96d.[0:16]: surface stats — length, word count, avg word len, cap rate, punct density, stop-word ratio, content-word ratio, is_question, is_negated, is_imperative, starts_with_conjunction, has_subject/verb/object guess, ends_with_?_!
embedding_layout_96d.[16:48]: n-gram buckets — 32 hashed word-bigram counts (blake2b → mod 32)
embedding_layout_96d.[48:64]: skeleton buckets — 16 binary content-word presence flags (blake2b → mod 16)
embedding_layout_96d.[64:80]: POS histogram — 16 buckets across (noun verb pronoun preposition conjunction determiner aux adj adv other)
embedding_layout_96d.[80:96]: chain context — position, shared-words-with-prior, subject-continuity, conjunction-cont, etc.

old_school_nlp_tricks: Stop-word filtering using a hand-curated ~100-word set (NO nltk)
POS proxy via suffix matching — verbs end in -ing/-ed/-en/-ize/-ize/-ify/-ate; nouns end in -tion/-ment/-ness/-ity/-er/-or; adverbs end in -ly/-ward; adjectives end in -ous/-ful/-able/-ive/-ic/-al
Subject-Verb-Object guess via 3-state machine over tokens
Skeleton = content words sorted + blake3 → deterministic semantic core
Chain context: prior sentences modulate current embedding (Markov-ish bias) — shared words, subject continuity, length deltas

inbound_callers: (planned) chat.py for cross-modal expert finding alongside wave/time/vector
outbound_calls: blake3 / blake2b for skeleton + crystal hashing

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.embed_3sentence_chain: 3 nodes with position-aware chain-context embeddings — pass
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.pos_proxy_accuracy_smoke: 5/9 obvious tokens correct (limits: numeric words, mid-list verbs without -ing/-ed)

limits_v0: Suffix-based POS misses irregular verbs (e.g., 'emits' not detected — no -ing/-ed)
Mistakes numeric words ending in -en (e.g., 'seven' tagged as verb)
Subject-verb-object is positional heuristic — won't handle passive voice, complex embedding
guarantees: Deterministic — same input → same 96-d vector, byte-exact
Sub-100ms per sentence on typical content
Free — no model load, no LLM call, no training cost
Composable — 4th MoE axis alongside vector / wave / time
usage_example: from sentence_chain import embed_chain, sentence_embedding, cosine_similarity\nnodes = embed_chain('Build the avatar. Connect depth, pose, TTS. Render sprite sheet.')\nprint(nodes[0].skeleton, nodes[0].crystal[:16])
